headline: Socovesa Reports Wider Losses and Lower Revenues Amid Weak Home Sales
summary: Socovesa reported deeper losses and falling revenues due to lower home sales, though the real estate developer reduced its net financial debt to 488.767 billion pesos.
why: Real estate developer earnings reflect housing demand, mortgage conditions, and property inventory turnover.

impacts.name: Housing Construction
impacts.why: Lower home sales and wider losses indicate declining revenue generation in the housing sector.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
